entity_types.name: Politician

attributes.description: The full legal name of the politician

attributes.name: political_affiliation
attributes.description: The political party or movement they belong to

attributes.name: current_role
attributes.description: The current official position held

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Officials representing their country in international relations and handling bilateral frictions.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the diplomat

attributes.name: representing_country
attributes.description: The country the diplomat represents

attributes.name: diplomatic_rank
attributes.description: The rank such as Ambassador or Consul General

entity_types.name: MilitaryOfficer

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the officer

attributes.name: military_rank
attributes.description: The military rank held

attributes.name: command_area
attributes.description: The specific region or unit under their command

entity_types.description: Individuals leading movements or protests regarding national sovereignty or political reform.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the activist

attributes.name: movement_focus
attributes.description: The primary political or social cause

attributes.name: influence_reach

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the analyst

attributes.name: expertise_area

attributes.name: institution_affiliation
attributes.description: The university or think tank they belong to

attributes.name: agency_name

attributes.name: country_location

attributes.name: primary_function

attributes.name: party_name

attributes.name: ideological_stance
attributes.description: The core political ideology

attributes.name: party_leader

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet

attributes.name: outlet_name

attributes.name: media_platform
attributes.description: The primary medium like TV, Digital, or Print

attributes.name: editorial_bias

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any individual not fitting specific categories, such as netizens or voters.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name or handle of the person

attributes.name: user_bio
attributes.description: Brief description of the individual

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Where the person is based

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any group, NGO, or collective not fitting specific categories.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization

attributes.name: org_type
attributes.description: The nature of the organization

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: The primary goal of the group

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Publicly expresses disapproval of another entity's actions or policies.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Engages in formal discussions to resolve frictions or reach agreements.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Provides news coverage or analysis regarding an entity's activities.

edge_types.name: ADVISES
edge_types.description: Provides expert recommendations or strategic guidance.

edge_types.name: MEMBER_OF
edge_types.description: Indicates formal membership or affiliation with a group.

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS
edge_types.description: Expresses public agreement or provides resources to another entity.

edge_types.name: MONITORS
edge_types.description: Observes the actions of another entity, often for security or compliance.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical landscape between Thailand and Cambodia. It focuses on key actors such as politicians, diplomats, and military officers who drive official policy, alongside activists, analysts, and media outlets who shape the social media discourse and public opinion surrounding regional frictions.
